people.name: Acolyte Una
people.firstMeet: In Meridia's Sanctum, the home of Meridia's Order.
changes: During Prisoner, once Alara has you ask the Order about Findar and until Infiltration is well along, she comes up to speak to you in the sanctum.
While Finding Yourself is under way (from the step where you travel with her to Meridia's Shrine until it ends) she follows you.
At points in Infiltration, Fort Justice and A New Day she sits in place for the scene instead of keeping her day.
Once A New Day is finished she lives at Fort Justice, about the fort all day, until The Pocket Realm starts.
From The Pocket Realm until early in The Ritual she stands at a set spot in Fort Justice all day.
Once The Ritual reaches the step to speak with Fiya, she stays at Fort Justice for good: 8 am to 8 pm about the fort, 8 pm to midnight wherever she is, midnight to 8 am at a set spot in the fort.

a step in it (one of the Order at Fort Justice)

If A Parting Gift ends with you talking him into leaving the Order for the one he loves, he moves to the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood and stays there all day; this beats everything else.
If you tell him you killed his ex-partner, he asks you to keep away from him.

At Sky Haven Temple, when it isn't raining or snowing, she practises outside by Karthspire: archery 8-10 am and 4-6 pm, swordplay 10 am-noon and 2-4 pm.
During Paarthurnax she and Esbern refuse to help further until you kill Paarthurnax.
